Modification: OrbitControls.js imports ./three.module.min.js instead of the
bare package name 'three'. The runtime has no CDN or other third-party requests.

The viewer's depth-based Eye-Dome Lighting pass is implemented locally in
point-cloud-renderer.mjs. It is not part of Three.js or a copied Potree shader.
